verdicts.title: Decomposition of sets in real algebraic geometry
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We present a new notion of decomposition of semialgebraic sets by introducing a mode of irreducibility based on arc-analytic functions. verdicts.title: Extension of Hodge norms at infinity
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: It is a long-standing problem in Hodge theory to generalize the Satake--Baily--Borel (SBB) compactification of a locally Hermitian symmetric space to arbitrary period maps.
